lines.zh: 我还记得去钟楼的路，脚自己走。
lines.en: My feet still know the way to the bell tower.

lines.zh: 洞穴很黑，我摸着石壁往前。
lines.en: The cave is dark; I feel along the stone wall.

lines.zh: 我们三个一起走，谁也不说话。
lines.en: The three of us walk together and no one speaks.

lines.zh: 我绕着村庄走了一圈，没进任何门。
lines.en: I circle the village once and enter no door.

lines.zh: 田里的作物枯了，我还去踩垄沟。
lines.en: The crops are dead; I still walk the furrows.

lines.zh: 菌丝从脚踝往上爬，我没去管。
lines.en: Mycelium climbs my ankle and I let it.

lines.zh: 夜里我才出来，白天躲在岩缝里。
lines.en: I come out at night and hide in crevices by day.

lines.zh: 我走路一瘸一拐，像挑着重担。
lines.en: I limp along as if carrying a heavy load.

lines.zh: 我经过自家门口，停了很久。
lines.en: I pass my own doorway and stand there a long while.

lines.zh: 石阶上还留着我的旧脚印。
lines.en: My old footprints are still on the stone steps.

lines.zh: 我跟在同伴后面，一步不落。
lines.en: I follow my companions and never fall a step behind.

lines.zh: 手里的铁锄早锈成一块疙瘩。
lines.en: The iron hoe in my hand has rusted into a lump.

lines.zh: 我沿着地下水声走，去找更暗的地方。
lines.en: I follow the underground water toward darker places.

lines.zh: 绿灯苔在脚边亮，我踩着它走。
lines.en: Glow lichen lights my feet and I walk on it.

lines.zh: 我张嘴想说话，只发出咕噜声。
lines.en: I open my mouth to speak and only gurgle comes out.

lines.zh: 我摸着脖子上的菌环，一圈硬壳。
lines.en: I touch the ring of fungus on my neck, hard as shell.

lines.zh: 我抬头看钟楼，钟早就掉了。
lines.en: I look up at the bell tower; the bell fell long ago.

lines.zh: 我数口袋里的绿宝石，只剩一颗。
lines.en: I count the emeralds in my pocket; only one is left.

lines.zh: 我蹲在地上，用指头划土。
lines.en: I crouch and draw lines in the dirt with one finger.

lines.zh: 我想不起自己的名字了。
lines.en: I cannot remember my own name.

lines.zh: 我朝空无一人的摊位点头问好。
lines.en: I nod a greeting to an empty stall.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴水，我张着嘴接。
lines.en: Water drips from the ceiling and I catch it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我搓着手，像在等一笔买卖。
lines.en: I rub my hands as if waiting on a trade.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处泛着淡绿。
lines.en: My eyes glow faint green in the dark.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有村民在说话，我没过去。
lines.en: I hear villagers talking far off and do not go.

lines.zh: 我把烂掉的胡萝卜摆成一排。
lines.en: I line up the rotten carrots in a row.

lines.zh: 我靠在岩壁上，慢慢滑坐下去。
lines.en: I lean on the rock wall and slide down to sit.

lines.zh: 我张嘴喘气，肺里有沙沙声。
lines.en: I gape for breath, a rasping sound in my lungs.

lines.zh: 我把手按在胸口，那里已经空了。
lines.en: I press a hand to my chest; it is hollow now.

lines.zh: 我抬头，洞顶的菌伞在滴水。
lines.en: I look up; the fungal caps overhead are dripping.

lines.zh: 我朝曾经的田地望了很久。
lines.en: I stare a long time at what used to be my field.

lines.zh: 我用手指敲墙，三下，停一停。
lines.en: I tap the wall three times, then pause.

lines.zh: 你看起来像个会买东西的人。
lines.en: You look like someone who would buy something.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，那里通常握着绿宝石。
lines.en: I stare at your hand, where emeralds usually are.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，想喊出欢迎光临。
lines.en: I open my mouth to say welcome, and nothing comes.

lines.zh: 我认出你不是村民，你不是同类。
lines.en: I can tell you are no villager, not one of us.

lines.zh: 我把头歪到一边，菌丝拉着皮。
lines.en: I tilt my head and the mycelium pulls my skin.

lines.zh: 你还穿着干净的衣服，真好。
lines.en: Your clothes are still clean. That is nice.

lines.zh: 我记得该鞠躬，可腰弯不下去。
lines.en: I remember to bow, but my back will not bend.

lines.zh: 我朝你伸手，掌心全是孢子。
lines.en: I reach toward you, palm covered in spores.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，才想起要眨眼。
lines.en: I watch you a long time before remembering to blink.

lines.zh: 你要买点什么吗？我什么都卖。
lines.en: Buying anything? I will sell whatever I have.

lines.zh: 你的脸让我想起村里的某个人。
lines.en: Your face reminds me of someone from the village.

lines.zh: 我轻声咕哝，像在报一个价。
lines.en: I mutter softly, as if quoting a price.

lines.zh: 我只剩一层护甲，疼得很实在。
lines.en: I have one point of armor; the pain is very real.

lines.zh: 我捂着伤口，血是暗色的。
lines.en: I clutch the wound; the blood is dark.

lines.zh: 别打我的头，那里已经空了。
lines.en: Not my head; there is nothing left in there.

lines.zh: 我倒下过一次，不想再来。
lines.en: I have fallen once and do not want to again.

lines.zh: 我发出嘶声，像坏掉的喉咙。
lines.en: I hiss through a throat that has broken.

lines.zh: 这一下打散了我肩上的一片菌。
lines.en: The blow scatters a patch of fungus off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，撞到同伴。
lines.en: I step back and bump into my companion.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，我想起自己叫什么。
lines.en: In the pain I remember what I was called.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看上去更不耐打。
lines.en: My body is frailer than it looks.

lines.zh: 别急，我还没有完全死透。
lines.en: Not so fast; I am not fully dead yet.

lines.zh: 绿宝石，你手里有绿宝石吗？
lines.en: Emeralds. Do you have emeralds in your hand?

lines.zh: 面包的味道，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell bread. I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我用一颗烂萝卜换你手里的东西。
lines.en: I will trade a rotten carrot for what you hold.

lines.zh: 你把绿宝石举起来，我的脚就动了。
lines.en: You lift the emerald and my feet start moving.

lines.zh: 那捆小麦，我从前一捆卖两枚。
lines.en: That bundle of wheat. I once sold two for an emerald.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，又缩回去，怕吓跑你。
lines.en: I reach out, then pull back so I do not scare you off.

lines.zh: 甜菜根也行，我不挑了。
lines.en: Beetroot will do. I am not picky anymore.

lines.zh: 我跟着那点甜味走了好几步。
lines.en: I follow that sweetness for several steps.

lines.zh: 交易的规矩我还记得一点。
lines.en: I still remember a little of how trading works.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我就当你买了。
lines.en: If you set it down, I will count it as sold.

lines.zh: 别撞我，我身上只剩一层皮。
lines.en: Do not bump me; I am down to one layer of skin.

lines.zh: 我被撞得踉跄，扶住了岩壁。
lines.en: The shove makes me stagger; I catch the rock wall.

lines.zh: 你已经挤到我的菌环上了。
lines.en: You are pressing right against my fungal ring.

lines.zh: 我们碰在一起，掉下几片干皮。
lines.en: We collide and a few flakes of dry skin fall.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，动作慢得可怜。
lines.en: I turn aside, and my movement is pitifully slow.

lines.zh: 护甲一点用都没有，我知道。
lines.en: One point of armor is useless. I know.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我没知觉。
lines.en: You step on my foot and I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我把肩膀缩起来，像在道歉。
lines.en: I hunch my shoulders as if apologizing.

lines.zh: 撞开的菌丝又慢慢合拢。
lines.en: The mycelium you knocked apart slowly closes again.

lines.zh: 我们撞得不重，我却站不稳。
lines.en: It was a light bump, yet I cannot stand steady.

lines.zh: 我们并肩坐着，谁也不提从前。
lines.en: We sit side by side and mention nothing of before.

lines.zh: 两只菌染村民之间，只有孢子往来。
lines.en: Between two infected villagers, only spores pass.

lines.zh: 她把头靠过来，菌丝缠上我的肩。
lines.en: She leans in and her mycelium knots over my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们本来该在教堂成婚的。
lines.en: We were supposed to marry in the chapel.

lines.zh: 同类靠近，我不再觉得孤单。
lines.en: When kin come near, I stop feeling alone.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着那口枯井。
lines.en: We keep watch over the dry well together.

lines.zh: 我用额头碰了碰她的额头。
lines.en: I touch my forehead to hers.

lines.zh: 没有誓言，只有同样的病。
lines.en: No vows, only the same illness.

lines.zh: 我们把烂掉的作物分了一半。
lines.en: We split the rotten harvest in half.

lines.zh: 她记得我的名字，我却忘了。
lines.en: She remembers my name; I have forgotten it.

lines.zh: 这枚绿宝石掉在地上，我捡起来。
lines.en: An emerald fell here; I pick it up.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡面包，膝盖响了一声。
lines.en: I bend for the bread and my knee pops.

lines.zh: 掉的东西都是我的，我全收着。
lines.en: Whatever drops is mine; I keep all of it.

lines.zh: 我把种子塞进嘴里，尝不出味道。
lines.en: I stuff seeds in my mouth and taste nothing.

lines.zh: 这块腐肉，我留着换东西。
lines.en: I keep this rotten flesh for a trade.

lines.zh: 我捡起木棍，当成手杖用。
lines.en: I pick up a stick and use it as a cane.

lines.zh: 地上的铁粒我一颗颗抠出来。
lines.en: I pry every nugget of iron out of the dirt.

lines.zh: 捡到东西要收好，这是习惯。
lines.en: Picked-up things go in the pocket. Old habit.

lines.zh: 我把你的掉落物摆在你脚边。
lines.en: I set your dropped items by your feet.

lines.zh: 我捡了又放下，拿不定主意。
lines.en: I pick it up and put it down, undecided.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我摆好的胡萝卜。
lines.en: You crushed the carrots I had lined up.

lines.zh: 我记得这张脸，和那天的一样。
lines.en: I remember that face; it matches that day.

lines.zh: 我停下动作，把头转向你。
lines.en: I stop moving and turn my head toward you.

lines.zh: 三个人一起上，这次不交易了。
lines.en: All three of us come at once. No trade this time.

lines.zh: 你身上那股活气，隔着洞都闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell the life on you across the cave.

lines.zh: 我本来想跟你换东西的。
lines.en: I was going to trade with you.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就跟进一步。
lines.en: You step back once; I step forward once.

lines.zh: 洞穴里终于来了个会喘气的。
lines.en: Something that breathes has finally come into the cave.

lines.zh: 我举起锈锄，手却不太听话。
lines.en: I raise the rusted hoe, but my hand will not obey.

lines.zh: 这次我不打算问价。
lines.en: This time I will not ask for a price.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙跟你走，省点力气。
lines.en: I follow along the wall to save my strength.

lines.zh: 我数着你走几步会停。
lines.en: I count how many steps you take before stopping.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我只剩一双绿眼睛。
lines.en: When you look back, only my green eyes remain.

lines.zh: 同伴从另一边绕，我们堵住你。
lines.en: My companions circle the other way; we box you in.

lines.zh: 我在等你靠近那摊菌丝。
lines.en: I wait for you to step near the mycelium patch.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁，我闻得出来。
lines.en: You carry iron; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪，脚底不出声。
lines.en: I shuffle slowly, my feet making no sound.

lines.zh: 别往亮处跑，那里不是我的地方。
lines.en: Do not run for the light; that is not my ground.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，像在田里拔草。
lines.en: I crouch low, as if weeding a field.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我张开嘴。
lines.en: The distance is right; I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 六点伤害，一下也就这样。
lines.en: Six points of damage. That is all one hit does.

lines.zh: 我抓着你的袖子，指甲抠进去。
lines.en: I grab your sleeve and dig my nails in.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，嘴里是土的味道。
lines.en: I bite down and taste dirt.

lines.zh: 我打得很笨，可我不停手。
lines.en: My blows are clumsy, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我还你两下。
lines.en: You hit me once; I give you two.

lines.zh: 我的指甲缝里全是孢子。
lines.en: My fingernails are packed with spores.

lines.zh: 这一下是为那摊烂胡萝卜。
lines.en: This one is for the rotten carrots.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，骨头咔咔响。
lines.en: I lunge, and my bones crack.

lines.zh: 我打不动你的护甲，还是打。
lines.en: I cannot get through your armor, and I keep hitting.

lines.zh: 你流血了，我闻着很熟悉。
lines.en: You are bleeding; the smell is familiar.

lines.zh: 黑暗里我睁开眼，海拔是负的。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the dark, below sea level.

lines.zh: 我们是三只一起来的，脚还没站稳。
lines.en: Three of us arrive before our feet are steady.

lines.zh: 我死在自己的村子里，又站了起来。
lines.en: I died in my own village and stood up again.

lines.zh: 菌丝先动，我才跟着动。
lines.en: The mycelium moves first; then I move.

lines.zh: 洞口的风吹进来，我闻到夜的味道。
lines.en: Wind enters the cave mouth and I smell night.

lines.zh: 这里太黑了，正好适合我。
lines.en: It is far too dark here. Just right for me.

lines.zh: 我记得倒下的那一刻，然后就黑了。
lines.en: I remember falling, then everything went black.

lines.zh: 我从岩壁的缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack in the rock.

lines.zh: 月亮出来的时候我就生了。
lines.en: I was born when the moon came out.

lines.zh: 我的手上还攥着死前抓的东西。
lines.en: My hand still clutches what I held when I died.

lines.zh: 这次是两只，我们踩着菌毯出来。
lines.en: Two of us this time, stepping out on a carpet of fungus.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先闻到了泥土和血。
lines.en: I open my eyes and smell soil and blood.

lines.zh: 火烧到菌丝，发出细小的爆裂声。
lines.en: Fire reaches the mycelium and it pops in tiny bursts.

lines.zh: 摔下来的时候，我听见骨头错位。
lines.en: As I fall, I hear a bone slip out of place.

lines.zh: 水流进肺里，比菌丝还冷。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs, colder than the mycelium.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，菌丝炸散一片。
lines.en: The explosion flips me over and scatters my mycelium.

lines.zh: 箭射穿了我，我低头看了看。
lines.en: The arrow goes through me; I look down at it.

lines.zh: 魔法烧过的地方，菌丝缩了回去。
lines.en: Where the magic passed, the mycelium shrinks back.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，我啃自己的手指。
lines.en: When hunger comes, I chew on my own fingers.

lines.zh: 雷照亮了洞穴，我缩进石缝。
lines.en: Lightning lights the cave and I shrink into a crevice.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，菌丝松开了我。
lines.en: As I fall, the mycelium lets go of me.
